title: Prepare script callable
summary: Recover the VM callable-metamethod insertion at 0x4f5380, including backward stack shift, capacity growth and pointer relocation via explicit helper services.
test_description: Direct original comparisons cover stack insertion at every position including the top, multiple stack lengths, spare space above and at the growth threshold, zero and positive capacity, moving allocation, frame and open-upvalue rebasing, allocator arguments, accounting and fixture contents. FS restoration is checked after each original call.
known_limits: Type errors, oversize errors and allocation failure transfer control through VM error helpers and are not exercised; services expose those dependencies without inventing them.
Original internal ABI uses ECX and EDX; the portable member accepts the helper services explicitly. VM layout and addresses are 32-bit.
Only controlled allocator and metamethod fixtures are tested; this does not validate the full VM or allocator.
